# dislop

> Cutting AI slop is real productivity. Linter for AI Slop (7 packs, 53 rules, 65 patterns, 90 tools) for agents and people.

## Quick Start & Agent Setup
1. Evaluate: inspect host (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, or web) and deliverables; pick Skill, CLI, or MCP via [Tools & Setup](https://dislop.com/tools/index.md).
2. Install: Skill `npx --yes skills add dislop-ai/dislop --skill dislop`; CLI `npx --yes dislop init` (Node 20+ / `uvx dislop`); Remote MCP `https://dislop.com/mcp` (0 cr check, no login).
3. First check: `npx --yes dislop check <path> --pack auto --compact --json` (exit `0`/`1`/`2`), summarize hits, and offer to fix.

## Start by task
- [Brief](https://dislop.com/tasks/business-doc.md): AI artifacts and `business-brief` rules.
- [Web & slides](https://dislop.com/tasks/web-and-deck.md): `deck-and-ui` rules and tokens.
- [Essay](https://dislop.com/tasks/editorial-writing.md): `literary-essay` rules and contrasts.
- [Pre-release gate](https://dislop.com/tasks/pre-release-gate.md): Core `error` checks and CI diff gating.

- [Methodology](https://dislop.com/methodology/index.md): Plain writing guide and visual tokens.

- [Awesome Anti-Slop](https://dislop.com/awesome/index.md): 90 tools & papers (`/awesome/index.json`).
- [Roadmap](https://dislop.com/roadmap.md): Active tracks and collaboration.

## Machine index & discovery
- [MCP Server Card](https://dislop.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): `/mcp` discovery (10 tools).
- [Agent Skills Index](https://dislop.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): `SKILL.md` & card sha256.
- [JSON Catalog](https://dislop.com/catalog.json): `dislop.catalog/1` manifest with sha256.
- [Agent Skill](https://dislop.com/tools/skill.md): `SKILL.md` mirror (`v0.8.4`).
- [Cloud MCP & API](https://dislop.com/tools/mcp-sdk-api.md): Remote MCP, OAuth 2.1, HTTP API.
- [Rule Packs](https://dislop.com/packs/core.md): 7 packs & 53 `/rules/<id>.md` cards.
- [Single-Fetch Bundle](https://dislop.com/llms-full.txt): All 53 rules without fixtures.
- [Privacy](https://dislop.com/privacy.md): Offline boundaries and Cloud MCP policy.
